title: helm: private values/init-hooks - KMS compatibility, nodeselector/tolerations and templating stabilizations
author: Priya Raman
body: Motivation: private installer customers running in air-gapped/VPC environments have hit two recurring issues during upgrades: 1) init hooks (postgres backup / kvcache warmup) fail when customers use nodeSelectors/tolerations for init jobs, and 2) KMS configuration and templating inconsistencies across k8s versions lead to runtime failures during chart render. This PR stabilizes the values schema and templates for the private Helm chart. Summary of changes: update values.schema.json to include top-level kms configuration with clear validation, add nodeSelector/toleration support to all initJob templates, normalize to using tpl+include patterns for version-safe templating, add a pre-upgrade hook that validates PV size and KMS key access before running migrations, and include migration docs and test cases. Backwards compatibility: values schema migration is additive; existing installs should continue to work. The PR also contains small refactors to make the init job image/tag configurable and to expose annotations for init jobs so customers can opt into cron/backup integrations. Testing: added unit template tests and an e2e install job that runs against a KinD cluster with a mocked KMS provider; CI runs helm lint, unit-template tests, and an e2e smoke install. Rollout plan: merge to main, cut patch release v3.7.2, barnstorm upgrade notes in the private installer docs, and follow up with a telemetry event to detect older value shapes during the next 2 weeks. Links: internal RFC (ENG-7023), installer upgrade runbook. Checklist: - [x] values schema updated and validated - [x] init job templates extended with nodeSelector/tolerations - [x] templating stabilized using tpl/include - [x] tests added (unit + e2e smoke) - [x] docs updated
commits: 1a9f4c3: chore(helm): add kms schema to charts/private/values.schema.json
2b7d1e5: feat(helm): support nodeSelector/tolerations for init jobs and backups
3c8d2f6: fix(helm): use tpl/include for secret/annotation templates to support k8scompat
4d9e3a7: feat(helm): add pre-upgrade hook to validate PV sizes and KMS access
5e0f4b8: test(helm): add unit template tests and kinD e2e smoke job
6f1a5c9: docs: update private installer upgrade docs and release notes
review_comments: Danny Li: Requested changes - please add unit tests for the secret templating path when kms.enabled=false to ensure no tpl invocation occurs.
Priya Raman: Thanks Danny, added unit test and updated the tpl wrapper to be no-op when kms.disabled. See commit 5e0f4b8.
Marta Ivanova: Nit: prefer explicit toleration key for init jobs so customers can target taints. Also add a comment in values.schema explaining the expected structure.
Priya Raman: Added tolerations key and expanded schema docs inline in values.schema.docs.md.
Ethan Cole: Verified e2e smoke install with mocked KMS provider; CI run passed locally but ran slow in CI. Consider adding a parallel tag to the job.
Priya Raman: Marked e2e job as optional in CI and added timing guard to avoid flakiness.
release_notes: Fixes: stabilize private helm values schema, add KMS configuration validation, support nodeSelector/tolerations for init hooks, add pre-upgrade checks for PV size and KMS access. Backwards compatible.
